#en: Once this place fed jump orders to fleets; now it is a hollowed-out skeleton buzzing on backup power, perfect for tucking away something that listens to the lanes without anyone officially admitting it exists. Buried in the old war-room circuitry, whatever has been humming along with modern traffic is still wired into forgotten UC relays and ghost beacons, quietly pulling patterns that point back to one man. The Grim Cohort holds the interior like they are guarding a bad conscience, and every story about why they are here contradicts the last. So far all anyone agrees on is that a wrecked freighter carried math it should not have had, and a retired command node has been whispering the same signature ever since.
zh: 这里曾经向舰队下达跃迁指令；如今它只剩一副被掏空的骨架，靠备用电力嗡鸣，恰好适合藏起某个监听航道、却没有任何官方承认其存在的东西。埋在那套旧作战室电路里的东西——无论是什么一直在与现代交通一同嗡鸣——仍接在被人遗忘的联殖中继与幽灵信标上，悄悄拉出那些指回一个人的模式。冷酷大队把守着内部，像在守卫一份不安的良心，而关于他们为何在此的每一种说法都与上一种矛盾。目前为止，所有人唯一认同的是：一艘损毁的货船携带着它本不该有的数学，而一个退役的指挥节点从此一直在低语着同一个签名。

#en: The relay squats in the dark like a memory everyone swears has faded, yet its antennae still rake the void for whispers no one admits are there. This is where the old diagnostics kept running after the technicians went home, where someone quietly spliced new code into forgotten UC routines and taught them to listen for patterns the official charts refuse to acknowledge. The gang camped here treats the place like just another salvage pit, but their guns say someone paid them to keep curious hands off the archives. So far the trail has been stolen sensor blocks, nervous testimony from a buried UC posting, and a growing realization that the same anomalies keep surfacing where the paperwork insists nothing is wrong.
zh: 那座中继蹲在黑暗中，像一段所有人都发誓已经褪色的记忆，可它的天线仍在扫过虚空，搜寻没人承认存在的低语。这里正是旧诊断程序在技师们回家后仍继续运行的地方，也是有人悄悄把新代码接进被遗忘的联殖程序、教会它们去聆听官方星图拒不承认的模式的地方。扎营于此的帮派把这地方当成又一个打捞坑，可他们的枪口说明，有人付了钱让他们别让好奇的手碰那些档案。目前为止，这条线索是被盗的传感器模块、某座被埋的联殖驻地传出的紧张证词，以及一种越来越清晰的认识：同样的异常不断出现在文书坚称一切正常的地方。

#en: If there is any place where unauthorized power work can go unnoticed, it is Gagarin Landing, with its half-abandoned plants and rusting conduits humming under cheap repairs. Buried in that tangle is the routing pattern that ties Vector's jump anomalies to real infrastructure, the kind of map only a former inspector or a very patient saboteur could assemble. Someone in UC coveralls clearly started to trace it, left half-finished annotations in the dust, and then simply stopped showing up for their shift. So far, the trail runs from a quiet cache on a backworld, through a gutted relay in orbit, into redacted oversight logs and a pattern of improvised power work that always bends toward the same uncharted coordinates.
zh: 若说有什么地方能让未经许可的电力工程不被注意，那就是加加林着陆点——半废弃的厂房、在廉价修补下嗡鸣的锈蚀导管。埋在那团乱麻里的，是那张把"向量"的跃迁异常系到真实基础设施上的线路图，只有前检查员或极有耐心的破坏者才拼得出来的那种地图。显然有个穿联殖工装的人开始追查它，在尘土里留下半途而废的批注，然后就再没来上过班。目前为止，线索从一穷乡星上安静的储藏点，穿过轨道上一座被掏空的中继，进入被涂黑的监督日志与一种临时拼凑的电力工程模式——它总是弯向同一批未标绘的坐标。

#en: The lower decks of Neon are where the city's power bleeds and its memories are scrubbed, which makes them perfect for hiding a record of paths no traffic controller will admit exist. Down here, runoff from the grid pools in forgotten channels, and only the people who live in permanent shadow can trace which conduits are official and which feed quiet side doors for salvagers who never pay docking fees. Somewhere in this dripping maze is the pattern that links anonymous jump entries to unmarked tows, a pattern first hinted at by a stray dataslate on a dead rock and half-erased manifests in a forgotten freight lot, then whispered again in the numbers behind a lonely memorial where settlers' names outnumber their ships.
zh: 霓虹城的下层甲板，是这座城市的电力渗漏、记忆被擦净的地方，这让它们成了藏起一份"任何交通调度员都不会承认存在的路径"记录的绝佳之处。在这下面，电网的溢流积在被遗忘的沟槽里，只有常年生活在阴影中的人才能分辨哪些导管是官方的、哪些通向打捞者悄悄进出的侧门——那些从不付停泊费的打捞者。在这座滴水的迷宫里某处，藏着那个把匿名跃迁条目与未标记拖运联系起来的模式；它最初由死寂岩石上一块散落数据板和废弃货运场里半擦除的舱单暗示，之后又在一座孤独纪念碑背后的数字里被低语重述——那里的定居者名字比他们的船只还多。

#en: Out here, on a nameless stretch of dirt far from the lanes, the air is thin and the sky is clean enough that no one bothers to look up when something goes wrong. That is exactly why he would test things here, where a bad harvest or a failing purifier can be shrugged off as frontier luck instead of design. Whatever is in these drums and soil reports will show whether the collapses were natural or tuned, whether his numbers have been walking ahead of the failures or pushing them. So far the trail is unsettlingly straight: a forgotten survey cache in the backcountry, an orbital log that did not match its own debris field, and corporate schedules that always seemed to tighten around the same kinds of fragile settlements.
zh: 在这里、在一段远离航道的无名土地上，空气稀薄，天空清朗到出了事也没人会抬头看。这正是他会在这种地方做试验的原因——在这里，一场歉收或一台损坏的净化器都能被当成边境的运气、而非设计，耸耸肩了事。这些桶里和土壤报告里的东西，会显示那些崩坏是自然的还是被调好的，他的数字是在那些失败之前先行、还是在推着它们走。目前为止，这条线索直得令人不安：偏远乡间一处被遗忘的勘探储藏点、一份与自身碎片场对不上的轨道日志，以及总是似乎围绕同样那些脆弱定居点收紧的公司日程。

#en: The abandoned UC listening post still hums with half-asleep systems, walls lined with scrubbed logs and redacted manifests that never made it back to central review. This is where quiet corrections were filed, where people learned that speaking plainly about missing ships and wrong jump angles could end a career, or worse. Whatever ledger was kept off the books here is one of the few places his edits and official silence overlap; without it, the pattern stays rumor.  \n\nSo far the trail has given you a stray datapad in backcountry rock and a buried monitoring station full of censored telemetry, each hinting that the same hand has been bending charts while everyone with clearance learned to talk around what they saw.
zh: 那座废弃的联殖听音哨仍带着半睡半醒的系统嗡鸣，墙上排着被擦净的日志与从未送回中枢复核的涂黑舱单。这里正是安静修正被归档的地方，是人们学到"把失踪船只和错误跃迁角度说清楚可能会毁掉前程、甚至更糟"的地方。此处账外留存的那本账，正是少数几个他的编辑与官方沉默重叠的地方之一；没有它，这个模式就仍是传闻。  \n\n目前为止，这条线索给了你一块落在乡间岩石上的散落数据板，以及一座塞满被审查遥测的被埋监测站，每一处都暗示同一只手一直在掰弯星图，而每一个有权限的人都学会了绕着他们所见的东西说话。

#en: Out here, between grav wells and patrol grids, is where someone like her would hang a listening post and never give it a name. The little beacon riding this orbit is doing more than navigation; its pulse is folded with routing updates, timing cues, and quiet course corrections that only make sense if you already know the pattern. Whatever coordinates she trusts enough to use repeatedly will be buried in those intervals, tucked between the numbers everyone pretends not to see. So far the trail runs from that empty frontier homestead, to the corrupted telemetry near its sky, to lab notes and substrate tests pointing at the same deep-space anomaly, each clue suggesting her next jump is charted just beyond official maps.
zh: 在这里、在引力井与巡逻网格之间，某个人会把她那样的听音哨挂在这里，且从不给它起名字。骑着这条轨道的小信标做的不只是导航；它的脉冲里折着航线更新、计时提示与安静的航向修正——只有在你已经知道那个模式时，它们才说得通。她信任到反复使用的任何坐标，都会埋进那些间隔里，夹在所有人都假装没看见的数字之间。目前为止，线索从那座空荡的边境农场，延伸到它天空中那处损坏的遥测，再到指向同一处深空异常的实验笔记与基底试验，每一条线索都暗示：她的下一次跃迁，已绘制在官方星图之外不远处。

#en: Ryujin's tower is where numbers stop being abstract and start deciding who gets to exist. If anyone is quietly tunneling through corporate ledgers and faction warrants, there will be fingerprints buried in the interfaces that supervise payrolls, benefits, and write-offs for half of Neon. The stories drifting through Ebbside say some quiet auditor out there can flip a foreclosure or vanish a bounty from behind a public terminal, and every retelling insists the access starts here, under glossy conference rooms and sanctioned data vaults. So far, the trail is a scratched dataslate on a backwater rock, a corrupted traffic beacon in orbit, and a derelict SysDef hull whose cargo logs rewrote themselves while the crew slept.
zh: 龙神大楼，就是那些数字不再抽象、而开始决定谁能存在的地方。若有人在悄悄钻穿公司的账册与派系令状，那在监督霓虹城半数薪水、福利与注销事务的界面里，一定埋着指纹。在埃布赛德流传的故事说，外面有个安静的审计员能从一台公共终端后面翻转一宗止赎、或让一笔赏金凭空消失，而每一次重述都坚称，入口就在这里——在光鲜的会议室与获批的数据金库之下。目前为止，这条线索是穷乡岩石上一块被划花的数据板、轨道上一座损坏的交通信标，以及一具废弃的星防队船壳——它的货运日志在船员睡觉时自己改写了。

#en: Out in high orbit, far from traffic lanes, the old recon grid still listens to nothing and remembers everything. This is where path and pattern can be separated from rumor, where the sky itself keeps a ledger no clerk can quietly amend. The sensor buoys hang in silence, but their last recorded vectors will show which shadowed corridor a salvager chose when he slipped through restricted airspace, and who helped him pass unseen.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a quiet cache on a forgotten rock to nervous half-truths in a backroom bar, then to a relay bunker where logs did not quite match the official story, and every time the subject edges close to certain derelicts, the people who were there stop meeting anyone's eyes.
zh: 在高轨道上、远离航道之处，那片旧侦察网仍在什么也听不到、却什么都记得。这里正是能把路径与模式从传闻中分离出来的地方，是天空本身保存着一本没有文书能悄悄修改的账簿的地方。传感器浮标静默地悬着，但它们最后记录的向量会显示：当某名打捞者溜过受限空域时，选了哪条阴影走廊，又是谁帮他无声通过。  \n\n目前为止，线索从被遗忘岩石上一处安静的储藏点，延伸到密室酒吧里紧张的半真半假，再到一座日志与官方说法对不太上的中继掩体；而每一次话题一逼近某些特定的弃船，曾在场的人就再也不与任何人对上目光。

#en: Down here beneath the gridwork and rain-streaked neon, the city's forgotten supports carry more than power; they carry secrets no one ever bothered to log. This is where back-channel brokers sketch their own version of the Settled Systems, marking which corridors are safe, which docks are watched, which names carry quiet protection. A single misdrawn line, a misheard registry digit, can strand a hauler in the wrong orbit or send a debtor straight into the arms of someone like Luc, and no one corrects the chart afterward. So far the trail is a lost dataslate on a backwater rock, cargo anomalies around Gagarin's loading bays, and whispers that the same unseen hand is redrawing routes for people as easily as for freight.
zh: 在这下面、在网格与雨痕斑驳的霓虹之下，这座城市被遗忘的支柱承载的不只是电力；它们还承载着没人费心记录的机密。这里正是暗渠掮客勾勒他们自己那版"定居星系"的地方：标出哪些走廊安全、哪些船坞被盯梢、哪些名字带着无声的保护。一条画错的线、一位听错的登记号，就能让一艘货船困在错误的轨道上，或把一个欠债人径直送进像吕克那样的人怀里，而事后没人去修正那张图。目前为止，线索是穷乡岩石上一块丢失的数据板、加加林星装货湾附近的货物异常，以及关于同一只隐形之手像改写货运一样轻易地改写人生航线的低语。

#en: Trade Authority hulls are supposed to be forgettable, moving other people's secrets on predictable lanes, but Deepwater TR-9346 hangs dead in the dark like a confession someone tried to erase. Whatever was worth killing the lights out here was important enough that crews in distant ports only mutter about it over half-finished drinks, afraid the wrong ears are always listening. If Rourke and Vector wanted a record of where they vanish between systems, this is where they would hide it, behind manifests and routing codes only smugglers and accountants understand. So far the trail runs from that isolated homestead to strange orbital telemetry, each whisper tying their movements to off-the-books cargo and vanished convoys.
zh: 贸易管理局的船壳本该是让人过目即忘的，在可预测的航道上运送别人的秘密，可"深水 TR-9346"死寂地悬在黑暗中，像一份有人试图抹掉的忏悔。无论是什么值得把这里的灯光都掐灭，它都重要到让远方港市的船员只敢在喝剩半杯时低声议论，唯恐总有错误的耳朵在听。如果鲁尔克和"向量"想要一份记录，记下他们在星系之间消失于何处，这里就是他们会藏它的地方——藏在只有走私者和会计才看得懂的舱单与航线代码之后。目前为止，线索从那座与世隔绝的农场延伸到古怪的轨道遥测，每一句低语都把他们的行踪与账外货物和消失的车队系在一起。

#en: Gagarin Landing is where the ground still remembers steel; pipe runs and service conduits here once tied directly into the same freight flow that fed the graveyard he haunts. Buried in these rusting backlines is the one piece of routing work he could not do alone, a quiet splice left for a partner who never came back to finish the job. If that forgotten connection still exists, it will translate local chatter and yard schedules into a path that mirrors his private drift between derelicts. So far, the trail runs from a lost dataslate on a nowhere rock, through a stripped Deimos lot and a silent relay bunker, each step peeling away the lie of random chance and exposing a deliberate orbit around old wrecks and older guilt.
zh: 加加林着陆点，就是大地仍记得钢铁的地方；这里的管线与服务导管曾经直接接入同一股货运流——正是喂养他所出没的那片墓地的那股流。在这些锈蚀的后线里，埋着一件他一个人做不成的线路工程：一处安静的接驳，留给了一个再没回来完工的伙伴。若那条被遗忘的连接仍然存在，它会把本地闲谈与船坞日程翻译成一条路径，一条映照他在弃船之间私人漂移的路径。目前为止，线索从一块鸟不拉屎岩石上丢失的数据板，穿过火卫二一片被剥光的场区与一座沉默的中继掩体，每一步都剥掉"随机巧合"的谎言，露出一个围绕旧残骸与更旧罪疚的刻意轨道。

#en: Down in Neon's underbelly, the air tastes like rust and Aurora bleed-off, and every corridor angles just enough to make you feel watched. If anyone is massaging risk for a living, their records will be buried where the house rigs every game and the losers keep coming back anyway. Here, nav-sellers and data snakes whisper over cheap drinks about routes that never make it onto official charts, and the same three-branched patterns keep surfacing in side-channel chatter before being laughed off in public. Back in Gagarin the captains only muttered about a ghost planner and strangely familiar corridors; now the numbers, the rumors of GalBank losses, and the quiet respect paid to a certain ex-navigator are starting to line up.
zh: 在霓虹城的下腹，空气尝起来像铁锈与极光渗漏，每条走廊都恰好拐出一点角度，让你觉得有人在看。若有人靠揉捏风险为生，他的记录就会被埋在赌场操纵每一场赌局、而输家却照样一次次回来的地方。在这里，导航贩子和数据蛇在廉价酒水上低声谈论从不上官方星图的航线，而同样的三岔模式不断在侧信道闲谈里浮现，然后被公开场合一笑带过。在加加林星，船长们此前只是嘟囔着一个幽灵规划者和似曾相识的走廊；如今，那些数字、关于盖尔银行亏空的传闻，以及人们对某位前领航员那份安静的敬意，开始对上了。

#en: This orbiting cache exists precisely because someone meant to clean it up and never came back; a freight ghost hanging off the lane, wrapped in a hull scarred by old burns and the lazy patrol patterns of the Specterborn. Log buffers are full, message queues jammed, manifests half-updated then abandoned, as if a clerk somewhere assumed a cleaner hand would sweep the data into silence. Instead it drifts, preserving a perfect record of where one particular hauler slipped off official routes and down toward quieter soil. So far the trail runs from a forgotten groundside cache to a dead archive in an abandoned lab, to retrofit notes in a dusty shipyard, each step tightening the circle around a single name everyone avoids saying.
zh: 这座轨道储藏点之所以存在，恰恰是因为有人打算清理它、却再没回来；一个挂在航道外的货运幽灵，裹在一具被旧烧伤与"幽魂生"懒散巡逻队形留下的伤疤所覆盖的船壳里。日志缓冲区满了，消息队列堵了，舱单更新到一半就被弃置，仿佛某处的文书以为会有更干净的手把这些数据扫入沉默。可它只是漂着，完美保存着某一艘货船偏离官方航线、滑向更安静土壤的记录。目前为止，线索从地面上一处被遗忘的储藏点，到一座废弃实验室里死掉的档案库，再到积灰船坞里的改装笔记，每一步都收紧着围绕一个所有人都不愿提起的名字的圆圈。

#en: Out here, away from patrol routes and station traffic, an Aegis agent chose to die with their back to bare rock and their notes locked behind personal encryption. Whatever they wrote, they wrote where no one could overhear, which means it cuts too close to the kind of truth that gets edited in committee rooms. The terrain is nothing, the air thin, the silence heavy, but that is exactly why the trail passes through this spot.  \n\nSo far I have a dead cache on a nameless world, a broken recorder in orbit, and whispers from New Atlantis about redacted audits and missing test crews; each piece feels straightforward on its own, yet together they keep slipping sideways every time I try to draw a clean line through Vector's path.
zh: 在这里、远离巡逻航线与星际站交通之处，一名宙斯盾特工选择背靠赤裸岩石死去，把笔记锁在个人加密之后。无论他们写了什么，他们都是在没人能偷听到的地方写的——这意味着它离那种会在委员会房间里被编辑的真相太近了。地形一片虚无，空气稀薄，沉默沉重，但这正是这条线索要经过此点的原因。  \n\n目前为止，我有一颗无名世界上的死掉储藏点、轨道上一台损坏的记录仪，以及来自新亚特兰蒂斯城的低语——关于涂黑的审计与失踪的试验组；每一块单独看都很直白，可一旦我试图为"向量"的路径画出一条干净的线，它们合在一起就总是往旁边溜。

#en: The scout hangs adrift in the dark like a redacted line in a report, its UC markings scoured by time and panic. Whatever passed through its nav-core was important enough for someone to let a Vanguard asset vanish rather than admit what it had seen. Inside, frozen telemetry and half-burned logs still remember the routes it was ordered to fly, the patterns someone tried to erase, the sketch of a grid that should not exist. If any record survived the purge, it will be here, between cold steel and dead consoles. So far, all we have is a scavenged dataslate from the fringe and fuel tallies that do not match declared flight plans, both pointing to hidden corridors in the lanes that captains whisper about but never quite agree on.
zh: 那艘侦察船在黑暗中漂泊，像报告里一行被涂黑的字，它身上的联殖标识被时间与恐慌磨蚀。凡是经过它导航核心的东西，都重要到有人宁可让一件先锋队资产消失，也不肯承认它看见了什么。里面冻结的遥测与半烧毁的日志，仍记得它奉命飞过的航线、有人试图抹掉的模式，以及一张本不该存在的网格草图。若说还有任何记录在清理中存活，它就在这里——在冰冷的钢铁与死掉的控制台之间。目前为止，我们只有一块从边境拾来的数据板，以及与申报飞行计划对不上的燃料统计，两者都指向航道中那些船长们低声议论、却从来对不上口径的隐藏走廊。

#en: The smell of coolant and burnt sealant hangs low in the maintenance bay, a permanent haze that makes every breath feel a little compromised, a little negotiated. Whoever keeps engines running here also keeps the local air monitors talking to the wrong people, and the crew that calls this place home looks just nervous enough to know it. The story is always the same: no one has heard of him, no one touches atmospheric firmware, everyone minds their own business while systems quietly rewrite themselves. From the forgotten outpost to the courier that vanished from its route, the pattern so far has been thin comfort layered over quiet sabotage, and this is the first place where fear and convenience finally share the same toolbox.
zh: 冷却液与烧焦密封胶的味道低低地悬在维修舱里，一层永久的雾气，让每一次呼吸都像打了点折扣、做了点交易。凡是让这里引擎不停的人，也让本地空气监测仪对错误的人说话；而把这个地方称作家的船员，看起来紧张得恰到好处，说明他们知道这一点。故事永远一样：没人听说过他，没人碰大气固件，人人只管自己的事，而系统悄悄改写着自己。从那座被遗忘的前哨，到那艘从航线上消失的信使船，目前为止的模式一直是薄薄一层安慰盖在安静的破坏之上，而这里是恐惧与便利第一次共用同一只工具箱的地方。

#en: RS-8275 Riftblade hangs in the dark like it died mid-thought, running lights off, systems idling just enough to keep the cold from chewing through the hull. If there is anywhere the story might be written plainly, it is on a ship like this, far from auditors and angry clients, its logs untouched since the last jump went wrong. Whatever record is tucked into its systems should be just numbers and routes, nothing mystical about it, yet everyone who mentioned this vessel spoke in careful hedges and changed the subject fast. So far the trail is thin but persistent: a datapad in the dust, jittering readings from a lonely monitoring shack, now a nameless hauler with drive history that does not quite match the story its owners told.
zh: RS-8275 裂隙之刃悬在黑暗中，像在思考到一半时死去：航行灯关闭，系统怠速到刚好不让寒冷咬穿船壳。若说这故事有哪里可能被平白地写下来，那就是这样一艘船上——远离审计员与愤怒的客户，自最后一次跃迁出错后日志再未被触碰。塞进它系统里的记录本该只是些数字与航线，毫无神秘可言，可每一个提起这艘船的人都措辞谨慎、迅速换个话题。目前为止，这条线索稀薄却执着：尘土里一块数据板、一座孤零零监控棚里抖动的读数，如今又是一艘无名的货船——它的引擎履历与船主讲的故事对不太上。

#en: The old relay bunker sits just outside the sweep of current patrol grids, a rusting nerve ending from a war everyone pretends is over. Its dishes still point at empty sky, listening, storing echoes in systems no one bothered to fully shut down. This is where a lone tech pulled atmospheric traces that did not match any registered flight plan, then walked away from their post and never raised their voice about it again. The data they stole is the only honest witness left. So far the trail runs like this: a buried dataslate in the frontier, careful half-truths in a Neon tower, then a SysDef hull adrift with logs that all agree on one thing, if nothing else the same signature keeps slipping through airspace that should be locked.
zh: 那座旧中继掩体恰好坐落在现行巡逻网格的扫描范围之外，一场所有人都假装已经结束的战争留下的一截锈蚀神经末梢。它的天线盘仍指向空荡的天空，聆听着，把回声存进没人费心彻底关掉的系统里。这里正是某名孤独技师拉出那些与任何登记飞行计划都对不上大气痕迹的地方，之后他离开岗位，再没为此出过一次声。他偷走的数据，是仅存的诚实证人。目前为止，线索是这样的：边境一块被埋的数据板、霓虹城某座塔里谨慎的半真半假，然后是一具漂泊的星防队船壳——它的日志至少有一点是一致的：同一个签名不断溜过本该被锁死的空域。

#en: The outpost is quiet in the way only abandoned military hardware can be, all dead screens and half-heard echoes in the ducting, but the lines are still listening. Buried in its cold racks are route corrections and signal ghosts no one ever meant to file, the kind of numbers you only keep when you want to bend traffic without leaving fingerprints. Whoever paid the Gutter Deadwater crew to squat here understands that; they are not guarding rubble, they are guarding a story that cannot stand daylight.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a stray dataslate on a forgotten rock to hushed boasts in backroom bars about ships that left port on one course and arrived along another, with a pilot no one names steering those quiet corrections.
zh: 那座前哨静得只有被遗弃的军用硬件才静得出来：全是死掉的屏幕与通风管里听不真切的回声，可那些线路仍在聆听。埋在它冰冷机架里的，是无人打算归档的航线修正与信号幽灵——那种只有想在不留指纹的情况下掰弯交通时，你才会留下的数字。付钱让"阴沟死水"那帮人蹲守于此的人明白这一点；他们守的不是瓦砾，而是一个见不得光的故事。  \n\n目前为止，线索从被遗忘岩石上一块散落数据板，延伸到密室酒吧里压低声音的吹嘘——关于船只从某个港口以一种航向出港、却沿另一种航向抵达，而一名没人点名提起的飞行员在操纵着那些安静的修正。

#en: It hangs in the dark just off the main traffic spine, a sliver of metal and code sitting where no registered beacon should be, yet close enough that every drifting hauler brushes its gravity well of bad advice. This is where the invisible hand on the lanes does its work, nudging convoys a fraction of a degree toward empty space or waiting guns, and the battered hull of the SL-6956 Dustshank circling it says someone has been profiting off that adjustment for a long time while everyone else looked the other way. So far the trail runs from a forgotten surface shack with wiped consoles and strange waypoint names to a dead lifeboat looped in panic, and every scrap of data points back to the same quiet reshaping of Narion's routes.
zh: 它悬在黑暗中，就在主交通主轴外侧，一片金属与代码的碎片，坐落在任何已登记信标都不该在的位置，却又近到每一艘漂过的货船都会蹭上它那个"坏建议"的引力井。这里正是航道上的隐形之手干活的地方——把车队朝空荡太空或等候的枪口推偏零点几度；而绕着它转的那具"SL-6956 尘胫"破旧船壳则说明，有人长期从这种调整里获利，而其他所有人都转开了视线。目前为止，线索从一座控制台被擦净、航点名字古怪的被遗忘地面小屋，延伸到一艘在恐慌中打转的死掉救生艇，而每一点数据都指回同一件事：纳里昂星航线的安静重塑。

#en: Out here the Deserted Relay Station is more than scrap; it is the last intact nerve in a network she has been carving up for years, the only place she can stand at the center of every blackout and pull the plug on whole systems at once. Its old UC hardware still ties cleanly into buried trunk lines, letting her flood the dark with one final burst of doctored truth or burn the raw records before anyone else can see them. Someone in uniform tried to erase those records long ago, but redacted logs, drifting cargo hulks, and hushed bar stories kept the shape of them alive; a dead ship with sabotaged relays, a frontier farm that went silent at the worst possible moment, and a trail of payments to outposts no one wanted on the books.
zh: 在这里，那座"被遗弃的中继站"不只是废铁；它是她多年来一直在切割的那张网里最后一根完好无损的神经，是她唯一能站在每一场断网中心、一次性掐断整套系统的地方。它那套旧联殖硬件仍干净地接在被埋的主干线上，让她能把改过手脚的真相以最后一次脉冲灌满黑暗，或在别人看到之前烧掉原始记录。很久以前有个穿军装的人试图抹掉那些记录，但涂黑的日志、漂着的货船残骸与压低声音的酒吧故事让它们的形状活了下来：一艘中继被破坏的死船、一座在最糟糕的时刻陷入沉默的边境农场，以及一串付给那些没人愿意记入账册的外站的款项。
